The [[Costa Rica]] 1892 census was elaborated by then {{lang|es|Dirección General de Estadística y Censos}}, predecessor of current [[National Institute of Statistics and Census of Costa Rica|National Institute of Statistics and Census]]. The total population was at the moment {{formatnum:243205}}.
